id: title:Piccirello:refresh ca bundles in metrics agent and hogql images

review.posthog_relevance: Updates the PostHog Agent container's CA certificate dependency and golang build image, potentially improving TLS trust and supply-chain security for the agent's outbound connections and HogQL language service.
review.reason: The change is a narrow, localized maintenance update to Dockerfile dependencies. P1.F1.H1 replaces the Alpine image and constrains the `ca-certificates` version to a post-compromise release, which could improve TLS trust and supply-chain security for the PostHog Agent. review.uncertainty: The complete runtime and test changes are not supplied, so the full impact of the golang image change and the complete behavior of the agent cannot be verified. The benefit is conjectural and not demonstrated by execution or tests.

observations.limitations: Only Dockerfile changes are supplied; no runtime, test, or configuration changes are shown. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Replaced Alpine image tag and added a versioned dependency constraint for ca-certificates; removed a comment, added a release note.
observations.posthog_connection: Updates the PostHog Agent container's CA certificate dependency to a version released after a compromise, potentially improving TLS trust and supply-chain security for the agent's outbound connections.

observations.behavior: Replaced the golang base image digest, changing the underlying container image while keeping the same tag.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the golang base image used to build the HogQL language service, potentially updating compiler, runtime, or dependency behavior; without the full build or test changes, the impact is unclear.
